protocol.runtime: llama.cpp b11865; Darwin x86_64; CPU; authenticated UNIX socket
protocol.embedding: 2048 dimensions, first 512 then L2 normalization for database trial

prompts.query: Represent the query for retrieving supporting documents:

protocol.qualityMethod: Frozen researcher-authored expected document per query. Small closed-world fixture; not an independent human-labelled benchmark.
protocol.qualityTuning: None; all questions and ranks retained, including misses.
protocol.databaseGate: Both engines must match exhaustive in-tenant top-five IDs using identical model vectors; compare quality separately from correctness.
protocol.cacheDiagnostic: Record the cosine similarity of contradictory permissions before selecting any cache threshold; no threshold fitted to this fixture.

exportTransformation: Only the response model metadata was changed from a local absolute filename to the public model identifier. All vectors, usage, ranks and timestamps are unchanged.
